reason: $24.99 for the first box is under a dollar a day, and the money-back guarantee means one box is a cheap try. The lab report and no magnesium oxide help, and I'd not pay full $29.99 without the launch deal.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference, or am I just paying for a nice box? And I forget my vitamins half the time, so I might not even finish the 30 sachets to qualify for the refund.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price ended or it was only available at $29.99 with no coupon, I would wait for the next sale.
